body:
Follow-up to task:4ea2064f16119df8, which fixed the moment: `cargo tauri build` runs the bundle step again and agents have `run bundle`.

This feature holds the fuller design from that task's discussion, as **investigations only**. Each task decides whether its part is worth doing and, if so, files the work task. Nothing here changes code until the human agrees.

Known debt it would address: the bundle step is written in three places (`tauri.conf.json`, the root `bundle` command, the frontend's `build-release`), and no decision record yet says `cargo tauri build` always remakes the pages (amends D-159, D-163).
title: build: bundles never go stale
